why: This is a description of one school's implementation of a shared technology space, with site-specific equipment, partnerships, learners, and access constraints rather than a general instructional element.
The HPL system is a named educational software interface that combines handwriting recognition with virtual or physical robot programming, rather than a general instructional element.
name: The handwriting programming language (HPL) system
product_description: The HPL system is a web-based computer-vision programming interface developed by Brender et al. that lets primary-school learners write program instructions by hand and execute the decoded commands through virtual or physical educational robots.

why: Healthy Primary School of the Future is a named, adoptable school-based intervention programme combining healthy lunches with structured physical activity and an extended school day.
name: Healthy Primary School of the Future (HPSF) intervention
product_description: A Dutch whole-school health intervention developed and delivered through school boards, regional public health services, and Maastricht University, combining free healthy lunches with daily structured physical-activity sessions.

why: This is a named, source-specific competency framework for hospice and palliative medicine physicians rather than a general instructional element or an implemented learning design.
name: Final consensus competency framework in three categories
product_description: A consensus framework defining 32 psychological-foundations, psychiatric-disorders, and systems-based-practice competencies for hospice and palliative medicine physicians, developed by the framework authors.

why: This is an education-research methodology for making ontological, epistemological, methodological, and axiological assumptions explicit, not a general theory of learning.
name: Explicit theoretical-framework and epistemological-assumption specification in education research

why: The WHO Health Promoting Schools framework is a named whole-school health-promotion framework, not a general theory of learning.
name: WHO Health Promoting Schools (HPS) framework
product_description: A World Health Organization framework for improving student health and well-being by integrating health into the curriculum, school ethos and environment, and family and community engagement.
